code: library(dockerfiler) # Create a dockerfile template my_dock <- Dockerfile$new() my_dock$MAINTAINER("Colin FAY", "contact@colinfay.me") my_dock$RUN(r(install.packages("attempt", repo = "http://cran.irsn.fr/"))) my_dock$RUN("mkdir /usr/scripts") my_dock$RUN("cd /usr/scripts") my_dock$COPY("plumberfile.R", "/usr/scripts/plumber.R") my_dock$COPY("torun.R", "/usr/scripts/torun.R") my_dock$EXPOSE(8000) my_dock$CMD("Rscript /usr/scripts/torun.R ") my_dock #> FROM rocker/r-base #> MAINTAINER Colin FAY <contact@colinfay.me> #> RUN R -e 'install.packages("attempt", repo = "http://cran.irsn.fr/")' #> RUN mkdir /usr/scripts #> RUN cd /usr/scripts #> COPY plumberfile.R /usr/scripts/plumber.R #> COPY torun.R /usr/scripts/torun.R #> EXPOSE 8000 #> CMD Rscript /usr/scripts/torun.R # Switch line 8 and 7 my_dock$switch_cmd(8, 7) my_dock #> FROM rocker/r-base #> MAINTAINER Colin FAY <contact@colinfay.me> #> RUN R -e 'install.packages("attempt", repo = "http://cran.irsn.fr/")' #> RUN mkdir /usr/scripts #> RUN cd /usr/scripts #> COPY plumberfile.R /usr/scripts/plumber.R #> EXPOSE 8000 #> COPY torun.R /usr/scripts/torun.R #> CMD Rscript /usr/scripts/torun.R my_dock$remove_cmd(8) my_dock #> FROM rocker/r-base #> MAINTAINER Colin FAY <contact@colinfay.me> #> RUN R -e 'install.packages("attempt", repo = "http://cran.irsn.fr/")' #> RUN mkdir /usr/scripts #> RUN cd /usr/scripts #> COPY plumberfile.R /usr/scripts/plumber.R #> EXPOSE 8000 #> CMD Rscript /usr/scripts/torun.R my_dock$remove_cmd(5:7) my_dock #> FROM rocker/r-base #> MAINTAINER Colin FAY <contact@colinfay.me> #> RUN R -e 'install.packages("attempt", repo = "http://cran.irsn.fr/")' #> RUN mkdir /usr/scripts #> CMD Rscript /usr/scripts/torun.R my_dock$add_after(   cmd = "RUN R -e 'remotes::install_cran(\"rlang\")'",    after = 3 ) my_dock$write()

title: dockerfiler 0.3.0
text: vendored copy renv (~30,000 lines inst/vendor/) removed. Lockfiles now parsed jsonlite::read_json() (already Imports). exported dockerfiler::renv symbol removed: public-API surface vendor pattern required . fallback renv_version value, user argument missing lockfile pin renv, now NULL (install latest renv configured repos), aligned existing renv_version = NULL behaviour. Closes #94. dock_from_renv() now defaults running runtime container rstudio user (previously root). generated Dockerfile gains defensive RUN id -u rstudio || useradd -m -d /home/rstudio -s /bin/bash rstudio early user created image already ship one (-op rocker/* images, real useradd r-base, ubuntu:*, debian:*). renv cache auto-derived /home/<user>/.cache/R/renv chowned <user> USER directive drops privilege; USER directive emitted right renv::restore() cache-mount RUN, every step needs root (apt-get, R installs) still runs root. Pass user = NULL opt keep previous root behaviour. debian/ubuntu ; alpine-based images must pass user = NULL create user . Closes #100. dock_from_renv() default flips "rocker/r-base" (amd64-) "rocker/r-ver" (multi-arch: linux/amd64 + linux/arm64), R version renv.lock file now appended codegen time (e.g. rocker/r-ver:4.5.0). Apple Silicon ARM Linux hosts (Ampere, AWS Graviton) now build natively without Rosetta. Pass legacy = "rocker/r-base" opt . Closes #47. dock_from_renv() default repos flips "https://cran.rstudio.com/" (source-CRAN mirror) "https://p3m.dev/cran/latest" (Posit Public Package Manager), automatic rewrite __linux__/$VERSION_CODENAME/ shape codegen time build pulls pre-compiled Linux binaries instead compiling source. Build time packages C/C++ deps drops minutes seconds. PPM rewrite logic now matches three Posit-managed PPM hosts: packagemanager.posit.co, packagemanager.rstudio.com, p3m.dev. Pass legacy repos = c(CRAN = "https://cran.rstudio.com/") opt . Closes #57.

title: dockerfiler 0.3.0
text: dock_from_desc() dock_from_renv() now validate every user-supplied parameter flows Dockerfile shell context (, , repos values names, extra_sysreqs, renv_version, renv_paths_cache, lockfile basename, use_pak, strict_install, plus r_version read lockfile). Inputs contain shell metacharacters, newlines, match documented format raise explicit error function entry, rather silently producing malformed Dockerfile one executes attacker-controlled commands docker build time. closes post-#106 audit follow-five sites surfaced Copilot review. Fixed long-standing code-injection path dock_from_renv(): renv package version resolved lockfile (lock$Packages$renv$Version) interpolated raw generated R -e 'remotes::install_version("renv", version = "<x>")' line without passing .validate_renv_version(). crafted renv.lock break inner R string execute arbitrary code root docker build time. user-supplied renv_version= argument validated since 0.3.0 shell-context hardening , lockfile-fallback path missed; bug predates 0.3.0 (existed vendored renv parser use). validator now applied resolved value whatever source. Found internal security audit release. Tightened .validate_r_version() “X.Y.Z Patched” branch require single literal space (previously used \s, R also matches newline tab): lockfile whose R$Version carried embedded newline pass validation emit two-line directive. exploitable command injection, silently break docker build.

title: dockerfiler 0.3.0
text: dock$ARG() internal add_arg() helper gain default parameter emit ARG <name>=<default> instead ARG <name>. Closes #8. dock_from_desc() dock_from_renv() gain github_pat parameter (default "none") controlling GitHub PAT provided remotes::install_github() / remotes::install_local() / renv::restore() private dependency repositories. Set "build_arg" emit ARG GITHUB_PAT + ENV propagation (passed via --build-arg GITHUB_PAT=$GITHUB_PAT), "secret" use BuildKit secret mounts (PAT never persisted image metadata; recommended published images). Closes #18. dock_from_renv() gains renv_paths_cache parameter controls RENV_PATHS_CACHE build-arg default, propagated ENV value, cache mount target. NULL (default), path auto-derived user: /root/.cache/R/renv user = NULL, /home/<user>/.cache/R/renv otherwise. Users can override renv cache location image build time --build-arg RENV_PATHS_CACHE=... without regenerating Dockerfile. dock_from_desc() gains strict_install parameter (default TRUE). TRUE, every install RUN generated Dockerfile prefixed options(warn = 2); R warning install (missing CRAN package, partial download, archived package, 404 remote) becomes hard error aborts docker build. behaviour change users regenerating Dockerfile: install RUNs now refuse silently swallow warnings. Pass strict_install = FALSE build environment routinely emits benign warnings (locale defaulting, NTP time-verification, ABI-version notices) want fail build. Closes #9.

title: dockerfiler 0.3.0
text: r() longer silently rewrites user code. previous implementation called gsub(" [2,]", " ", code) (typo {2,}) deleted digit 2 comma preceded space: r(c(1, 2, 3)) returned R -e 'c(1, , 3)'. replacement approach (gsub("[ ]{2,}", " ", code)) still collapsed runs spaces inside string literals (r(cat(" b")) emit R -e 'cat("b")'). fix uses trimws() deparse() line paste(collapse = " "): line-wrap indentation added deparse() removed, internal whitespace preserved. Closes #95. r() now wraps deparsed R expression shQuote(., type = "sh") instead inlining inside hand-rolled single-quoted shell string. Apostrophes inside string literals longer break emitted command: r(message("")) used emit R -e 'message("")', shell refuses parse (unterminated quoted string). new wrapping shell-safe construction. dock_from_desc(build_from_source = FALSE) longer carries dead-code branch ((missing())) locally-assigned result pkgbuild::build(). missing() reports unsupplied function arguments, branch unreachable; success path always ran build() returned. branch removed; failures pkgbuild::build() propagate normally via stop(). Closes #98. Small polish bundle (behavioural changes end users): fix two length(x > 0) typos dock_from_desc() (intent length(x) > 0); drop duplicate @export tag dockerignore.R; use new dock$ARG(name, default = ...) form internally instead inlining =; tighten previously brittle regression test checked occurrence "remotes" generated Dockerfile.

title: dockerfiler 0.2.6
text: dock_from_renv() now auto-configures generated Dockerfile fetch Linux binaries Posit Package Manager repos single CRAN-keyed PPM URL. Four things happen: PPM URL rewritten include __linux__/$VERSION_CODENAME/ (resolved image build time /etc/os-release) cran cran/latest; HTTPUserAgent set strict format PPM requires; renv.config.repos.override set renv::restore() uses PPM instead lockfile’s repo URL; RUN prefixed . /etc/os-release && line uses $VERSION_CODENAME. User-pinned codenames snapshot-date URLs (e.g. cran/2024-01-15) preserved -. user’s PPM scheme host (packagemanager.rstudio.com URL stays rstudio.com) preserved rewrite. Non-PPM repos (including internal mirrors official PPM hosts) multi-entry repos vectors left untouched. dock_from_renv() longer installs remotes renv_version = NULL, since remotes needed install_version() path.
